```{r dataset}
data = read.csv("../dataset/dataset_clorofilla_filtrata_3anni.csv")

# Round coordinates to 3 decimal places to match with the distance dataset
data$Lon = round(data$Lon, 3)
data$Lat = round(data$Lat, 3)

# Dataset of the distances
ordered_distances = read.csv("../dataset/bordo_con_distanze.csv")
data_pos = data %>%
  inner_join(ordered_distances, by = c("Lat", "Lon"))

ordered_distances <- ordered_distances %>%
  filter (Lat >= 45)

# Final dataset
chl_pos = data_pos %>%
  dplyr::select(Date, Lat, Lon, Chl, distanza_cumulata)

chl_pos$Date = as.Date(chl_pos$Date)

# Parameters
n_days = length(unique(chl_pos$Date))
```

```{r functional data setup}
colours = viridis(n_days)

# Define B-spline Basis
basis = create.bspline.basis(
  rangeval = range(x), 
  breaks = x,           # Placing knots at real data points
  norder = 4            # Cubic splines
)

# Convert discrete data to functional objects
chl_fd <- Data2fd(argvals = x, y = t(data_matrix), basisobj = basis)

# Comparison between Raw Data and FDA Smoothing
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
matplot(x, t(data_matrix), type = "l", lty = 1, lwd = 1, col = colours,
        xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Chl", main = "Original Data (Raw)")
plot(chl_fd, col = colours, lty = 1, lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Chl", main = "FDA Smooth (B-splines)")
# Highlight knots on the plot
knots = c(basis$rangeval[1], basis$params, basis$rangeval[2])
abline(v = knots, col = "gray90", lty = 3)
rug(knots, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r prediction setup, echo=TRUE}

date_disponibili <- as.Date(rownames(data_matrix))
start_val <- which(date_disponibili == as.Date("2024-05-01")) # Esempio

n_val = 7
n_cal = 20

indici_train <- 1:(start_val - 1)
indici_cal <- start_val:(start_val + n_cal - 1) # Usato per calibrazione (conformal prediction)
indici_val   <- (start_val + n_cal ):(start_val + n_cal + n_val - 1)

# Split dei coefficienti
coef_train <- chl_fd$coefs[, indici_train]
coef_val   <- chl_fd$coefs[, indici_val]
coef_cal   <- chl_fd$coefs[, indici_cal]

# Ricostruzione oggetti FD
train_fd <- fd(coef_train, basis)
val_fd   <- fd(coef_val, basis)
cal_fd <- fd(coef_cal, basis)

# Aggiorna i metadati (nomi delle date) per non fare confusione nei plot
train_fd$fdnames$reps <- chl_fd$fdnames$reps[indici_train]
cal_fd$fdnames$reps <- chl_fd$fdnames$reps[indici_cal]
val_fd$fdnames$reps   <- chl_fd$fdnames$reps[indici_val]
#################
n_comp = 4

chl_pca_train <- pca.fd(train_fd, nharm = n_comp)

# Estrarre gli score per il training
train_set <- chl_pca_train$scores[, 1:n_comp]

# Split into Training and Validation sets
#train_set <- scores_data[1:(n_tot - n_val), ]


# Define ground truth curves for error calculation
curve_reali <- chl_fd[(n_tot - n_val + 1):n_tot]

# Function to calculate functional RMSE day by day
compute.daily.rmse <- function(curve_reali, curve_predette) {
  diff_fd <- curve_reali - curve_predette
  integrali_quadrati <- diag(inprod(diff_fd, diff_fd))
  return(sqrt(integrali_quadrati))
}
```

```{r VECM prediction, echo=TRUE}
# Extract predicted scores
#scores_var <- sapply(pred_var_obj$fcst, function(x) x[, "fcst"])
#if(nrow(scores_var) != n_val) scores_var <- t(scores_var)

# Reconstruct functional profiles
scores_vecm_val <- as.matrix(predict(fit_vecm, n.ahead = n_val))
curve_vecm_val_fd <- fd((chl_pca_train$harmonics$coefs[, 1:4] %*% t(scores_vecm_val)) + 
                        as.vector(chl_pca_train$meanfd$coefs), basis)


fitted_train_scores <- fitted(fit_vecm) 
n_fitted <- nrow(fitted_train_scores)
cal_pred_scores <- fitted_train_scores[(n_fitted - n_cal + 1):n_fitted, ]

curve_cal_pred_fd <- fd((chl_pca_train$harmonics$coefs[, 1:4] %*% t(cal_pred_scores)) + 
                         as.vector(chl_pca_train$meanfd$coefs), basis)

grid_x <- seq(basis$rangeval[1], basis$rangeval[2], length.out = 200)
eval_cal_real <- eval.fd(grid_x, cal_fd)           # Actual curves in cal period
eval_cal_pred <- eval.fd(grid_x, curve_cal_pred_fd) # Predicted curves in cal period
eval_val_real <- eval.fd(grid_x, val_fd)           # Actual curves in val period
eval_val_pred <- eval.fd(grid_x, curve_vecm_val_fd) # Predicted curves in val period

```

```{r adaptive conformal prediction, echo=TRUE}
# 1. ACI Parameters
gamma <- 0.01       # Learning rate (step size for adaptation)
alpha_target <- 0.05 # Target error rate (95% coverage)
alpha_t <- alpha_target # Initial alpha

res_matrix <- abs(eval_cal_real - eval_cal_pred)
initial_scores <- apply(res_matrix, 2, max) 

# 2. Containers for results
aci_upper <- matrix(0, nrow = length(grid_x), ncol = n_val)
aci_lower <- matrix(0, nrow = length(grid_x), ncol = n_val)
k_values <- numeric(n_val)

# 3. Sequential Update Loop
for (t in 1:n_val) {
  # A. Calculate k_alpha based on current alpha_t
  # Ensure alpha_t stays in a valid range (0, 1)
  prob_val <- 1 - max(0, min(alpha_t, 1))
  k_t <- quantile(initial_scores, probs = prob_val, type = 1)
  k_values[t] <- k_t
  
  # B. Construct Band for Day t
  pred_t <- eval_pred[, t]
  aci_upper[, t] <- pred_t + k_t
  aci_lower[, t] <- pmax(0,pred_t - k_t)
  
  # C. Check Coverage (Did the real curve stay inside the band?)
  real_t <- eval_val_real[, t]
  # We check if the MAX error of the day exceeded our threshold k_t
  max_err_t <- max(abs(real_t - pred_t))
  error_occured <- if (max_err_t > k_t) 1 else 0
  
  # D. Update alpha_t for the NEXT day (The "Adaptive" step)
  alpha_t <- alpha_t + gamma * (alpha_target - error_occured)
}

for(t in 1:n_val){
  plot(grid_x, eval_val_pred[, t], type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, max(aci_upper)),
     main = paste("ACI Forecast: Day", t),
     xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Chl")

  polygon(c(grid_x, rev(grid_x)), 
          c(aci_upper[, t], rev(aci_lower[, t])), 
          col = rgb(0, 1, 0, 0.2), border = NA)

  lines(grid_x, eval_val_real[, t], col = "black", lty = 2)
  legend("topright", legend=c("Predicted", "Actual", "ACI Band"), 
        col=c("blue", "black", "green"), lty=c(1, 2, 1), pch=c(NA, NA, 15))
}



```

```{r ACI on log_trasformed data - preliminaries, echo=TRUE}
# 1. Define the grid and transform
grid_x <- seq(basis$rangeval[1], basis$rangeval[2], length.out = 200)
log_valori <- log(eval.fd(grid_x, chl_fd))
log_chl_fd <- smooth.basis(grid_x, log_valori, basis)$fd

# 2. Extract scores for the entire period
log_pca_obj <- pca.fd(log_chl_fd, nharm = n_comp)
all_scores <- log_pca_obj$scores

# 3. Precise Indexing
# Let's say: Training -> Calibration -> Validation
idx_train <- 1:(start_val - 1)
idx_cal   <- start_val:(start_val + n_cal - 1)
idx_val   <- (start_val + n_cal):(start_val + n_cal + n_val - 1)

train_scores <- all_scores[idx_train, ]
cal_scores   <- all_scores[idx_cal, ]   # Ground truth scores for cal
val_scores   <- all_scores[idx_val, ]   # Ground truth scores for val

# 4. Fit VECM on Training
log_fit_vecm <- VECM(train_scores, lag = 7, r = 3, estim = "ML")

# 5. Get Predictions for Calibration Period
# We predict n_cal steps ahead starting from the end of train_scores
pred_cal_scores <- as.matrix(predict(log_fit_vecm, n.ahead = n_cal))

# 6. Reconstruct Functional Objects for Calibration
# Use the harmonics and mean from the PCA to turn scores back into curves
log_curve_cal_pred_fd <- fd((log_pca_obj$harmonics$coefs[, 1:n_comp] %*% t(pred_cal_scores)) + 
                             as.vector(log_pca_obj$meanfd$coefs), basis)

# 7. Evaluate on grid for the ACI residual matrix
eval_cal_real <- eval.fd(grid_x, log_chl_fd[idx_cal])
eval_cal_pred <- eval.fd(grid_x, log_curve_cal_pred_fd)

log_res_matrix <- abs(eval_cal_real - eval_cal_pred) # Dimensions now match!
```

```{r ACI on log_trasformed data, echo=TRUE}
alpha_t <- alpha_target # Initial alpha

#log_eval_cal <- eval.fd(grid_x, log_cal_curves)      # Calibration curves

log_initial_scores <- apply(log_res_matrix, 2, max)

log_aci_lower <- matrix(0, nrow = length(grid_x), ncol = n_val)
log_k_values <- numeric(n_val)

# 3. Sequential Update Loop

  prob_val <- 1 - max(0.001, min(alpha_t, 0.999)) # AVOID ERRORS

  log_k_values[t] <- k_t
  
  # B. Construct Band for Day t
  pred_t <- exp(log_eval_pred[, t])
  log_aci_upper[, t] <- exp(log_eval_pred[, t] + k_t)
  log_aci_lower[, t] <- exp(log_eval_pred[, t] - k_t)
  
  # C. Check Coverage (Did the real curve stay inside the band?)
  log_real_t = eval.fd(grid_x, log_val_curves[, t])
  max_log_err <- max(abs(log_real_t - log_eval_pred[, t]))
  # We check if the MAX error of the day exceeded our threshold k_t
  error_occured <- if (max_log_err > k_t) 1 else 0
  
  # D. Update alpha_t for the NEXT day (The "Adaptive" step)
  alpha_t <- alpha_t + gamma * (alpha_target - error_occured)
}

for(t in 1:n_val){

        col=c("blue", "black", "green"), lty=c(1, 2, 1), pch=c(NA, NA, 15))
```
